hook: One line in your cloud invoice just jumped by 21.9% starting October 1, 2026.

sections.voiceover: One line in your cloud invoice just jumped by 21.9% starting October 1, 2026.
sections.visual_cue: Close-up of OVHcloud pricing dashboard showing updated invoice totals.

sections.voiceover: On October 1, 2026, OVHcloud stopped including a local disk and a public IPv4 address in Generation 3 instances. Where did those components go?
sections.visual_cue: Split-screen graphic showing unbundled storage and IP components.

sections.voiceover: Worse, webhosting.today analyst Łukasz Nowak shows hourly costs hit €0.0001458 per gigabyte.
sections.visual_cue: Display of webhosting.today article header with analyst name.

sections.voiceover: OVHcloud price increases land between 1.4% and 21.9% for identical configurations.
sections.visual_cue: Data chart showing hourly rates of 0.0001458€ and 0.0027€.

sections.voiceover: Those unbundled fees hit every Generation 3 instance.
sections.visual_cue: Final graphic showing OVHcloud B3, C3, and R3 server tiers.
